decision: Invalid baseline/candidate comparison: both labels linked the same library and identical executable bytes.
cause: Both isolated workspaces shared CARGO_TARGET_DIR and the unqualified release/libhyperreal.rlib output. The candidate Cargo invocation reported fresh after the baseline build and returned the same library bytes. Source hashes alone did not prove which artifact was linked.
retention: All fixed samples and original results remain unmodified. No measured candidate speedup, regression, allocation or executable-size comparison is credited from cost-v1.
correction: Fork the runner; use separate target directories and dependency search paths, record each source manifest and package identity, require distinct baseline/candidate library and executable hashes before sampling.
